To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a library of five hitherto unknown unsymmetrical N, N-diiminoacenaphthene ligands have been synthesized and employed to prepare their nickel(II) complexes.
a series of unsymmetrical N, N′-diimine ligands bearing electron withdrawing difluoro-benzhydryl groups have been synthesized and successfully employed in the synthesis of their nickel(II) complexes.

the nickel(II) complex of the unsymmetrical N, N′-diiminaacenaphthylen-2-yl-4,6-bis(4′-fluoro-benzhydryl)-phenylamine, Ni5, is a highly efficient catalyst for the polymerization of ethylene to produce high molecular weight polyethylene (Mn = 4 × 105, Mw = 1 × 106, Tm 50.8
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of a series of unsymmetrical N, N′-diimine ligands and their corresponding Ni(II) halides complexes and the application of the later in ethylene polymerization.
the synthesis and characterization of a new series of N,N′-diphenyliminoacenaphthylene ligands and their corresponding Ni(II) complexes.
the development of a new family of N,N′-Ni(II) halides with a difluorobenzydryl group as a ligand and the use of such compounds as catalysts for ethylene homo-polarization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of electron withdrawing difluoro-benzhydryl groups appended to the N,N′-iminoacenaphthylene ligands has a positive impact on the ethylene polymerization catalytic activity and the resulting polyethylene elastomer properties.

the use of electron withdrawing difluoroaryl group in the backbone of N,N′-bis(aryl)-substituted acenaphthylenes is an effective strategy to achieve high catalytic activity towards ethylene polymerizations.
the present work provides an alternative approach to access polyethylene elastomers with a high degree of control over molecular weight, molecular weight distribution, and crystallinity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the N,N′-Ni(II) catalyst system appended with electron-withdrawing difluorobenzyldryl group, in combination with MAOs, is capable of producing polyethylene elastomers with high molecular weight and narrow polydispersities.

the use of the new unsymmetrical N, N′-diimine ligand L5 in combination with either MAO or Et2AlCl has led to the preparation of a new family of nickel(II) catalyst that is highly active towards ethylene homo-polarization and produces high quality elastomeric polyethylenes.

we have successfully developed a novel class of N,N′-diaminoacenaphthylene nickel catalyst with high activity towards ethylene homo-polarization, which is able to afford a high molecular weight elastomer with good elastomeric properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the incorporation of the electron-withdrawing difluorobenzyldryl substituents on the N,N′-diphenyliminoacenaphthene backbone is a viable strategy for the synthesis of highly active nickel(II)-based catalysts, which are able to produce polyethylene materials with high elastomeric recovery and tensile properties.
the use of N,N′-Ni(II) catalyst with electron withdrawing group on the N,N′-imine moiety is a promising route for the preparation of polyethylene with elastomeric properties.
the electron-withdrawing benzhydryl substituents on the diimine backbone have a positive impact on the ethylene polymerization performance of the nickel(II) complexes.
